description: Sequential PocketPolyglot queue for the complete public-domain collections of Cao Cao, Cao Pi, and Cao Zhi.

generation_contract.source_fidelity: Preserve the authoritative Wikisource wenyan text, collection order, work titles, source citations, and verse-line relationships. Do not modernize or silently correct the source spine.
generation_contract.english: Produce complete, accurate, literary but understandable modern English without summary or invented interpretation.
generation_contract.japanese: Produce complete, natural contemporary Japanese with kana and normal Japanese inflection; reject kanbun-like Chinese strings presented as Japanese.
generation_contract.modern_chinese: Produce complete, clear modern Chinese that explains the classical meaning without merely repeating the wenyan wording.
generation_contract.references: Use the private annotated scans only when alignment is evidenced. Never copy modern editorial prose wholesale, and never claim an English or Japanese source edition that is not locally present.
generation_contract.grammar_analysis: Populate normalized grammar roles for color-capable JSON; pinyin belongs only on matching Chinese tokens and furigana only on kanji-bearing Japanese tokens.
generation_contract.finalization: After full manifest coverage, compile maximum-language large-font wenyan-main color and black-white PDFs with cover, meaningful TOC, and chapter starts on new pages.
